JWT.Secret: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set JWT:Secret 'your-512-bit-secret'

StreamingApi.ApiKey: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set StreamingApi:ApiKey 'your-rapidapi-key'

Google.ClientId: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Authentication:Google:ClientId 'your-client-id'
Google.ClientSecret: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Authentication:Google:ClientSecret 'your-secret'
Google.IosClientId: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Authentication:Google:IosClientId 'your-ios-client-id'
Google.AndroidClientId: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Authentication:Google:AndroidClientId 'your-android-client-id'

Redis.ConnectionString: Retrieved from User Secrets - same as ConnectionStrings:Redis

Resend.ApiKey: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Resend:ApiKey 'your-resend-api-key'

Stripe.SecretKey: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Stripe:SecretKey 'sk_test_...'
Stripe.PublishableKey: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Stripe:PublishableKey 'pk_test_...'
Stripe.WebhookSecret: Retrieved from User Secrets - run: dotnet user-secrets set Stripe:WebhookSecret 'whsec_...'
